current_revision.mathematical_scope: The surface proof gives four local models and all moving blowups with arbitrary finite basepoints: C_(2,d-1), R x Y_(d-2), the angle-3pi/2 Euclidean cone and R^2. A surjection between compact geodesic spaces with distortion <=delta gives based same-radius closed-ball GH distance <=3delta/2. Applied to the same f=p_T pi under a->infinity, a/R->0 and R epsilon/a->0, this transfers all subsequential limits and realizes every type for any admissible scale and degeneration sequence. The existing uniform component-core/collar result is retained. Fixed source-inclusive residual compacts and shell radii precede the small-complex-t threshold. The co-Gram lemma is a finite-parameter inequality; vanishing errors are imposed only in the final slow diagonal. General cone geometry and GH transfer are not claimed as new.
